source: Plan v2: 20 TDD competencies reduced to a smaller set (6-8) for a clean radar chart. Each item lists the TDD §8 codes it merges (tdd:Cxx tags).

data.name: Strategy & Enterprise Thinking
data.definition: Business strategy, strategic choices, business models and end-to-end enterprise structure, translated into initiatives and financial outcomes.

data.name: Research & Problem Structuring
data.definition: Industry and market research with source discipline; issue trees, hypotheses, MECE thinking, prioritisation and synthesis.

data.name: Value Chain, Process & Operating Model
data.definition: Value chain mapping, process and capability design (BPMN/SIPOC/value streams) and target operating model components and trade-offs.

data.name: Transformation, Change & Delivery
data.definition: Current/future state, roadmaps, change and adoption, organisation and governance, programme prioritisation, risk and benefits realisation.

data.name: Data, Commercial & AI Awareness
data.definition: Quantitative and financial reasoning, KPI and value-case design, and responsible enterprise AI opportunity framing.

data.name: Executive Communication
data.definition: Structured writing and speaking, brevity, audience adaptation and recommendation storytelling.

data.name: Stakeholder Leadership & Collaboration
data.definition: Listening, facilitation, influence, teamwork and cross-cultural client readiness.

data.name: Professional Judgement & Learning Agility
data.definition: Ethics, confidentiality, evidence-based challenge and escalation; curiosity, feedback response and ambiguity tolerance.
